notes.subject: Kristy call notes — final handwritten batch
notes.body: Kristy's June sheet lists West Yellowstone 4th of July as a one-day event, 406-646-7701, and says emailed June 2. Gmail confirms Adventure Zone later declined 2026 only because our calendar was already full, not because the event rejected us.
